title: JetBrains Air — Agentic Development Cheat Sheet
brandSub: Agentic tasks · Parallel agents · Cloud runs · Automations · MCP · Review

rows.label: Install (macOS)
rows.value: Download from air.dev; Linux via JetBrains Toolbox; Windows planned 2026

rows.label: First launch
rows.value: Connect at least one AI provider before any task can run

rows.label: JetBrains AI sub
rows.value: Single subscription unlocks Claude Agent, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Junie

rows.label: BYOK
rows.value: Connect Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google directly with your own API key

rows.label: Add provider later
rows.value: Settings → Account → AI Providers → Connect

rows.label: Open project
rows.value: File | Open (local folder) or Git | Clone (enter repo URL in Source URL)

rows.label: Trust prompt
rows.value: Click Trust to enable full features; Preview limits scripts but is safer for unknown repos

rows.label: Git required
rows.value: Air needs a Git repo in the workspace to create and run tasks

rows.label: Cloud agents (EAP)
rows.value: Run tasks in remote containerized environments via air.jetbrains.cloud

rows.label: Automations (EAP)
rows.value: Schedule or event-triggered tasks that run in cloud without manual start

rows.label: Incoming webhooks
rows.value: Trigger automations via HTTP POST; token in Authorization: ApiKey <token>

rows.label: Outgoing webhooks
rows.value: Post automation results to Slack (slack-workflow format) or any URL

rows.label: Review with Agent
rows.value: Dedicated agent review session launched via Chat or /review slash command

rows.label: Plan mode (all agents)
rows.value: Available for every agent even if native CLI lacks it; plan stored in .air/plans/

rows.label: Skills
rows.value: Reusable workflow modules in .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md for progressive context

rows.label: Voice input
rows.value: Local Whisper model for dictating prompts — no audio sent to cloud

rows.label: Start a task
rows.value: Open Chat tool, describe goal + what done means, press ↩ Enter or Send

rows.label: Add context (@)
rows.value: Type @ in task input to attach files, folders, symbols, Git items, terminals

rows.label: Add from editor
rows.value: Select code → right-click → Add to Task for pinpoint context

rows.label: Slash commands
rows.value: Type / to open slash menu: built-in commands, agent commands, custom commands

rows.label: Upload file
rows.value: Type / → Upload File from Computer to add logs, screenshots, specs

rows.label: Project instructions
rows.value: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/ auto-loaded by Air per agent

rows.label: Voice dictation
rows.value: Click microphone icon in task input; stop with stop button when done

rows.label: Effort level
rows.value: Set Effort selector (Low → Max) to trade reasoning depth vs. token cost

rows.label: Local Workspace
rows.value: Fastest startup; agent writes directly to your working copy — no isolation

rows.label: Git Worktree
rows.value: Separate branch & working copy on your machine; main copy untouched

rows.label: Docker
rows.value: Full container isolation; requires Docker Desktop + valid license

rows.label: Cloud (EAP)
rows.value: Remote container; result pushed to task branch on remote repo automatically

rows.label: worktree.json
rows.value: Configure env vars & setup cmds in .air/worktree.json for Git Worktree tasks

rows.label: docker.json
rows.value: Set image, user, env, setup cmds in .air/docker.json; image must include Git

rows.label: Cloud lifetime
rows.value: Cloud environment available up to 24 hours; then deleted — result stays on branch

rows.label: Cloud startup script
rows.value: .air/cloud/startup.sh runs after clone, before agent — must be idempotent

rows.label: Claude Agent
rows.value: Connect via Anthropic Console API billing (Pro/Max/Team accounts not permitted)

rows.label: OpenAI Codex
rows.value: Connect via ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Team subscription or OpenAI Platform API billing

rows.label: Gemini CLI
rows.value: Connect via Google Account (Personal/Workspace) or Google AI Studio API billing

rows.label: Junie
rows.value: Connect via JetBrains account; bundled under JetBrains AI subscription

rows.label: Select agent
rows.value: Click model selector in task toolbar → choose agent group → pick model

rows.label: Switch model mid-task
rows.value: You can change model in an ongoing task but not the provider/agent

rows.label: Review model
rows.value: Set a dedicated model for agentic review: Settings → Global → AI → Review → Agent review model

rows.label: Credits
rows.value: JetBrains AI subscription deducts AI credits per agent & model used

rows.label: Plan
rows.value: Agent drafts a Markdown plan in .air/plans/; you approve before implementation starts

rows.label: Ask / Default
rows.value: Agent requests approval before editing files or running commands

rows.label: Edit / Auto-Edit
rows.value: Agent edits files automatically; fewer prompts than Ask, more limits than Full Access

rows.label: Full Access
rows.value: Fewest restrictions for that agent — use only in trusted projects

rows.label: Cycle modes
rows.value: Press Shift+Tab in the task toolbar to cycle through available permission modes

rows.label: Implement dialog
rows.value: After plan is ready, choose agent, model, and run environment before execution

rows.label: Plan best for
rows.value: Multi-file changes, unclear scope, or tasks needing clarifying questions first

rows.label: Thinking level
rows.value: Gemini CLI & Codex expose a reasoning level selector in the task toolbar

rows.label: Symbols context
rows.value: Type @ → symbol (file must be open in editor first)

rows.label: Git branch/commit
rows.value: Type @ → select branch or commit as baseline or regression evidence

rows.label: Local changes
rows.value: Type @ → Local Changes to let agent continue unfinished work

rows.label: Terminal output
rows.value: Attach open terminal session via @ for debugging tasks needing console logs

rows.label: Documentation
rows.value: Type @ → Documentation → Add Documentation (name + URL); reuse via @

rows.label: Shared skills path
rows.value: .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md — available to all agents

rows.label: Agent-specific skills
rows.value: .claude/skills/, .codex/skills/, .gemini/skills/, .junie/skills/

rows.label: Custom commands
rows.value: Claude: .claude/commands/<name>.md · Gemini: .gemini/commands/<name>.toml · Junie: .junie/commands/<name>.md

rows.label: New parallel task
rows.value: Press ⌘⇧N or View | Tasks → New Task to launch another agent concurrently

rows.label: Tasks tool
rows.value: View | Tasks (⌘1) shows all tasks with state: Running, Input required, Suspended

rows.label: Input required
rows.value: Task pauses when it needs clarification; switch to it, answer, continue

rows.label: Resume suspended
rows.value: View | Tasks → select Suspended task → click Resume; send follow-up if needed

rows.label: Avoid conflicts
rows.value: Run tasks on same files in Git Worktree or Docker to prevent edit collisions

rows.label: Group tasks
rows.value: Settings icon in Tasks → group by Date, Status, or Target

rows.label: Fan-out pattern
rows.value: Start independent sub-tasks in parallel; review and steer each rather than fire-and-forget

rows.label: Cloud from IDE
rows.value: In AI Assistant (IntelliJ), select JetBrains Cloud agent to start cloud tasks without leaving IDE

rows.label: Open diff
rows.value: After task finishes, click Changes in Chat tool → Task Changes editor tab

rows.label: Diff views
rows.value: Toggle Unified / Side-by-side in diff header; navigate hunks with navigation controls

rows.label: Comment on line
rows.value: Select line in diff → Add Comment; collect several then Send Comments as batch

rows.label: Add to follow-up
rows.value: Select code in diff → Add to Task → enter follow-up instruction

rows.label: Review with Agent
rows.value: Click Review with Agent button in Chat or Task Changes tab for automated review pass

rows.label: Review scope
rows.value: Choose Task Changes, All Local Changes, or arbitrary files/folders/commits/branches

rows.label: Send accepted comments
rows.value: In Comments tool, select accepted review comments → Send → main agent updates code

rows.label: Global review prompt
rows.value: Settings → Global → AI → Review → Edit to set default focus (style, security…)

rows.label: Local workspace
rows.value: Task Changes → enter commit message → Commit; then push to remote

rows.label: Generate commit msg
rows.value: Click Generate Commit Message icon next to Commit in Changes or Git tool

rows.label: Apply Locally
rows.value: For Git Worktree/Docker tasks: Task Changes → Apply Locally copies changes as uncommitted

rows.label: Checkout Branch Locally
rows.value: Drop-down on Apply Locally → creates local branch air/<task>-copy for PR workflow

rows.label: Revert single file
rows.value: Changes tool → Task Changes tab → Revert icon next to file name

rows.label: Revert all
rows.value: Changes tool → Task Changes tab → Revert All icon

rows.label: Roll back branch
rows.value: History tool → right-click commit → Reset Current Branch To Here → pick Mixed/Keep/Hard

rows.label: Cloud task PR
rows.value: After cloud task: review pushed task branch → Create PR in web UI or VCS provider

rows.label: Enable MCP
rows.value: Settings → AI → MCP Servers → Enable MCP support

rows.label: Global MCP server
rows.value: Available in all projects; stored in global Air settings

rows.label: Local MCP server
rows.value: Project-specific; stored in .air/mcp.json in project root

rows.label: Workspace MCP server
rows.value: Reuses standard .mcp.json in repo root; enable Launch workspace MCP servers

rows.label: Bearer token auth
rows.value: Provide token directly in mcp.json headers; env-var tokens not supported

rows.label: OAuth MCP
rows.value: Server appears with Connect button; click to authorize via provider's OAuth page

rows.label: VCS providers
rows.value: Connect GitHub or GitLab in air.jetbrains.cloud → Settings → Integrations

rows.label: Org repos (admin)
rows.value: Admin must install JetBrains Air app for org before org repos appear in Air

rows.label: Manage automations
rows.value: Log in to air.jetbrains.cloud → Automations page

rows.label: Schedule trigger
rows.value: At time: run at specific time on selected days; Repeat every: fixed interval (e.g. 2 h)

rows.label: GitHub event triggers
rows.value: PR Opened/Updated/Merged/Review Requested/Labeled; Issue Opened/Labeled

rows.label: Webhook trigger
rows.value: POST to .../api/v1/events/automations/<id> with Authorization: ApiKey <token>

rows.label: Outgoing webhook
rows.value: Add Notification → Webhook URL; payload includes statusUrl and result/error

rows.label: Slack format
rows.value: Slack trigger URL auto-selects slack-workflow format with flat outputText/errorText

rows.label: Visibility
rows.value: Private (owner only) or Organization (visible to all, editable by owner only)

rows.label: Run manually
rows.value: Select automation → Run Now to test on-demand without waiting for a trigger

rows.label: Create config
rows.value: air.jetbrains.cloud → Settings → Environments → New Configuration

rows.label: VM sizes
rows.value: Small (2 CPU/8 GB), Medium (4/16), Large (8/32), Extra Large (16 CPU/64 GB/100 GB disk)

rows.label: Internet access modes
rows.value: Off · Specified domains · Trusted domains (preset list) · All domains

rows.label: Personal secrets
rows.value: Encrypted, only visible to you; exposed as env vars in cloud environment

rows.label: Env vars vs secrets
rows.value: Use Environment Variables for non-sensitive config; Personal Secrets for tokens/passwords

rows.label: Startup script
rows.value: .air/cloud/startup.sh: runs after clone, before agent — make it idempotent

rows.label: Export var to agent
rows.value: Append to ~/.bashrc in startup script (export in script process does not persist)

rows.label: Config per user
rows.value: Each user has one config per repo; shared configurations are not yet supported

rows.label: Go to All
rows.value: ⌘K or ⇧⇧ — search files, symbols, actions, tools in one popup

rows.label: Find action
rows.value: ⌘⇧K — jump directly to Actions tab of Go to All

rows.label: Open tools
rows.value: ⌘T — jump to Tools tab; type name e.g. Chat, Files, History

rows.label: Text search
rows.value: ⌘⇧F — full-project text search with regex, folder scope, file mask

rows.label: Push
rows.value: ⌃G ⌃P — push local commits to remote tracked branch

rows.label: Pull
rows.value: ⌃G ⌃U — pull latest changes from remote into current branch

rows.label: Find usages
rows.value: ⌘U or ⌘+click on symbol

rows.label: Go to definition
rows.value: ⌘B; implementations ⌘⌥B; type definition ⌘⇧B

rows.label: Open Settings
rows.value: ⌘, — Global tab for all workspaces; project tab for current workspace only

rows.label: .air/settings.json
rows.value: Workspace settings: excluded paths, visual guides, terminal profiles

rows.label: .air/mcp.json
rows.value: Project-level MCP server configuration (commit to share with team)

rows.label: .air/review/review-prompt.md
rows.value: Project-specific review guidelines; overrides global review prompt

rows.label: .claude/settings.json
rows.value: Shared Claude Agent settings checked into source control

rows.label: .claude/settings.local.json
rows.value: Personal Claude Agent settings — NOT committed to version control

rows.label: Keymap setting
rows.value: Settings → General → Keymap: supports IntelliJ IDEA and VS Code presets

rows.label: Vim emulation
rows.value: Settings → General → Enable Vim emulation (experimental, limited functionality)

rows.label: Bound tasks win
rows.value: Give each task a single, verifiable goal — broad tasks produce harder-to-review diffs

rows.label: Fan out safely
rows.value: Run independent sub-tasks in parallel using Git Worktree to avoid edit conflicts

rows.label: Plan before big changes
rows.value: Use Plan mode for multi-file or uncertain tasks; review the plan before approving

rows.label: Stay on approval path
rows.value: Keep Ask or Plan mode for sensitive commands; Full Access only in trusted repos

rows.label: Narrow internet access
rows.value: Set cloud env to Trusted domains or Specified domains rather than All domains

rows.label: Idempotent startup scripts
rows.value: Guard every step in startup.sh — the script reruns on every environment resume

rows.label: Review before trust
rows.value: Use Review with Agent for a fast first pass, but manually verify critical behavior

rows.label: Version-control .air/
rows.value: Commit .air/ (except secrets) to share worktree, docker, MCP, and review config
